  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

panels.description:
Construction proofs verified per hour, by log, from the kt_witness_audit_verified_total counter.

Named proofs rather than epochs because the unit differs by log: an epoch for the AKD directories and Proton, a published entry for entry logs. Calling all of them epochs would overstate what an entry log has done.

panels.description: Epochs of published history with a settled construction-audit decision. A coverage level, not throughput — it only counts work inside the backfilled range.

targets.query:

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and r._field == "kt_witness_history_audited_epochs")
  |> group(columns: ["origin"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "origin"])

panels.title: Published history audited, by log

panels.description: How far there is to go before a log can honestly claim tier B+. Absolute epochs rather than a percentage: a percentage sits near zero for a long time and hides whether anything is happening.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "server")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stack == "kt-witness" and (r._field == "kt_witness_history_total_epochs" or r._field == "kt_witness_history_audited_epochs"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["origin"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, origin: r.origin, _value: r.kt_witness_history_total_epochs - r.kt_witness_history_audited_epochs}))
  |> group(columns: ["origin"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "origin"])
